name: course_status_convention_key_v1
purpose: Evaluation only. Three of the supplied curricula encode compulsory/option status in their own course codes. The status reader (curriculum_understanding.course_status) never reads codes; it reads the scheme layout. Agreement with each institution's code convention is therefore an independent check of the reader on real documents. Courses whose code matches no pattern are not scored.
label_source: INSTITUTION_CODE_CONVENTION (read off the documents by the author; not human-validated)
